name: pointable-context
description: Selection-triggered, zero-turn development context reveal in the native Codex Chat Lane.

interface.shortDescription: Select a reference and reveal verified context in place.
interface.longDescription: Keep the Codex Chat Lane quiet until the user selects a stable file, module, decision, test, configuration, or explicitly authored context reference. A trusted explicit action reveals bounded, type-specific detail beside the selection without opening a browser, calling a model, or creating another chat turn. Explicit concept, change, decision, task, and verification artifacts project compact mental models with evidence kept behind a local disclosure. Opt-in Agent record maintenance runs only at stable milestones and is gated by a read-only structure, identity, time, and exact-evidence check. Open workspace cards pin their snapshot, signal detected file revision drift, and refresh in place only after another trusted action. Test source never implies PASS/FAIL, task completion and verification results are never inferred, ordinary prose is never semantically mined, configuration values stay hidden, and browser clients plus DCPM/CWA are not product dependencies.
